text: DSH Thinking Status Customizer 是一款 DSH Web 插件，用于自定义运行中思考状态的视觉呈现。它在页面提供悬浮设置面板，通过 CSS 为状态添加流动文字、动画图片或图文组合。用户可以编辑文字、颜色、流动方向和速度模式，选择 GIF、APNG 或 WebP 图片，并即时预览和保存设置。适合希望个性化 DSH Web 等待状态显示的用户。设置保存在浏览器本地，不需要 API Key 或额外服务。

DSH Thinking Status Customizer styles the running status in DSH Web. Its floating panel offers flowing text, an animated image, or both, with controls for colors and motion. Users can preview and save settings locally. GIF, APNG, and WebP images are supported; no API key is needed.
想把 DSH Web 思考时的状态文字换成自己喜欢的内容。
有没有办法给运行中的状态加流动彩色文字？
让 DSH 等待时显示我选的动画图片。
我想同时在思考状态旁边展示图片和文字。
Can I customize the running status shown while DSH is thinking?
I want an animated image in the DSH Web waiting indicator.
How can I change the colors and motion of the thinking status?
DSH 思考时的提示太单调了，想换成动画效果。
DSH Thinking Status Customizer 的功能「自定义流动文字」：在设置面板编辑状态文案、选择两到五种颜色、流动方向和连续或往返运动，并预览后保存。
DSH Thinking Status Customizer 的功能「动画图片状态」：可使用内置动画、图片 URL 或本地 GIF、APNG、WebP 文件替换状态视觉；选择图片后可预览并保存。
DSH Thinking Status Customizer 的功能「图文组合显示」：将动画图片与自定义文字并排用于思考状态，用户可在面板切换模式并调整图片尺寸。
DSH Thinking Status Customizer 的功能「双语设置面板」：根据 DSH 当前语言切换中文或英文界面，并提供开关、预览、保存、恢复默认和关闭操作。
DSH Thinking Status Customizer 将设置及合规大小的 Data URL 图片保存在浏览器 localStorage；较大的本地图片使用临时对象 URL，仅当前标签页有效，刷新后需重新选择。
DSH Thinking Status Customizer 对外部 HTTPS 图片地址由浏览器直接请求；配置此类图片时，浏览器会连接该图片地址。

dsh-thinking-status-customizer README · DSH Thinking Status Customizer：[中文](README.zh.md)

A CSS-only DSH Web plugin that replaces the visible running status with custom flowing text, a GIF/APNG/WebP animation, or a combined image-and-text display without modifying DSH source or rewriting the status DOM.

dsh-thinking-status-customizer README · Install：Install the tagged release into a Web profile, inspect the resolved configuration, then restart DSH Web:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:Dbi-Eshuh/dsh-thinking-status-customizer#v0.2.2
dsh --profile web --dump-config
```

dsh-thinking-status-customizer README · Install：Open the floating **Thinking status** button after restart. Click the same button again, use the close button, or press Escape to close the panel. The plugin follows the active DSH language setting and updates its English or Chinese interface immediately without discarding unsaved form values; user-authored custom text is preserved verbatim. The dialog can enable or disable the visual replacement and switch among custom text with a flow effect, an animated image, and a left-image/right-text combination. Text modes support two to five custom colors, four flow directions, and continuous or back-and-forth movement. Image modes include a roughly 12-second dance GIF with a transparent background and also accept an HTTPS/Data URL or a local GIF, APNG, or WebP up to 20 MB. Local files above 2 MB remain uncompressed and use a temporary object URL, so they work only in the current tab and must be selected again after a reload.

dsh-thinking-status-customizer README · Install：The settings panel inherits DSH Web's light or dark theme tokens and previews text, color count, colors, flow direction, movement pattern, animation, and size edits before they are saved.

Remove the plugin and restart DSH Web to restore the built-in presentation:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-thinking-status-customizer
```

dsh-thinking-status-customizer README · Behavior and privacy：The default mode is the custom text `正在吃饭中...` with a flow effect. Settings and Data URL images up to about 3 MB are stored only in browser `localStorage` under `dsh-thinking-status-customizer:v1`; larger local images use a temporary object URL and are not persisted. The plugin does not upload settings, status text, images, or model interaction. When an HTTPS image URL is configured, the browser requests that URL directly. Missing, corrupt, or unavailable storage resolves to defaults without stopping the page.

dsh-thinking-status-customizer README · Behavior and privacy：The stylesheet targets only `[data-conversation-scroll] [role="status"][aria-live="polite"]`. It adds a layout-participating pseudo-element and plugin-owned CSS properties; it does not observe the page, replace `textContent`, or target other live-status elements. Disabling or unloading the plugin removes its style, controls, attributes, CSS properties, and event listeners.

dsh-thinking-status-customizer README · Behavior and privacy：The original DSH status remains in the accessibility tree. This plugin therefore changes visual copy only; assistive technology continues to receive the built-in status text.

dsh-thinking-status-customizer README · Compatibility：The current release is tested with DSH Web `0.1.0-rc.6`. It relies on the semantic selector above because `ui-conversation` does not expose a running-status text provider in that release. A DSH update that changes the selector can make the visual replacement inactive; the plugin remains loaded and its dialog reports that it is waiting for a matching status.

dsh-thinking-status-customizer README · Compatibility：This package uses only the public DSH bundle, client-module loading declarations, and client locale service. It does not patch `ui-conversation` or depend on private DSH build helpers.

dsh-thinking-status-customizer README · Develop and verify：```sh
npm install
npm run verify
```

`lib/index.js` and `lib/client.js` are committed so GitHub installation does not require an install-time build. `npm run verify` type-checks, tests, rebuilds, confirms the committed bundles match the source, and previews the package contents.

dsh-thinking-status-customizer README · Model Experience：None. The plugin adds no tool, prompt, model-visible input or output, session event, or model behavior. It changes only browser-local presentation of an existing running status.
